# nemau_network (Resource)

An isolated virtual network in the project.

`name` and `description` change in place: the segment keeps its identifier, so the subnets and instances attached to it are untouched.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nemau_network" "app" {
  name        = "app"
  description = "Application network"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Network name. Changes in place.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description. Changes in place.

### Read-Only

- `external` (Boolean) True for the region's external network, never for one created here.
- `id` (String) Network id.
- `status` (String) Status as reported by the platform.

## Import

```shell
# A network imports by its id.
terraform import nemau_network.app 2a9f4e7c-1d3b-4a85-b6e2-7c0d9f3a5e16
```
